description: This file defines a Java class 'ThingUpdater', an Akka actor responsible for handling persistence updates related to a single 'thing' in the system. It manages the state of the thing's revision, process various messages including event tags, policy tags, update commands, and handles clean shutdown via timeout or passivation.

classes.name: ThingUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor managing persistence updates for a specific 'thing', handling message processing, metadata management, and actor lifecycle within the system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create actor Props for a ThingUpdater instance.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior, including processing of ThingEvent, ThingTag, PolicyReferenceTag, UpdateThing, UpdateThingResponse, timeout, and default logging for unknown messages.

methods.name: exportMetadata
methods.description: Exports current metadata state of the thing and policy revisions.

methods.name: enqueueMetadata
methods.description: Overloaded method to enqueue provided metadata.

methods.name: processThingTag
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingTag messages, updates revision if newer, and enqueues metadata.

methods.name: updateThing
methods.description: Handles requests to update the search index for a thing.

methods.name: processUpdateThingResponse
methods.description: Handles response after update attempt, re-enqueues metadata upon failure.

methods.name: processPolicyReferenceTag
methods.description: Processes new policy references, updates policy info if newer, and enqueues metadata.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming thing events, updates revision if newer, and enqueues metadata.

methods.name: tryToGetThingId
methods.description: Attempts to derive the ThingId from the actor's name.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Decodes actor name to generate a ThingId.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for a streaming message to the sender.
